summary: Ayr Wellness filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 1, 2026 news release announcing the closing of the transfer of its Ohio operations into wholly-owned subsidiaries of Arboretum Bidco LLC, completing the first Ohio asset transfer. Earlier this year Ayr transferred its Virginia, Florida, New Jersey, and Nevada operations to Arboretum, the entity established by Ayr's senior secured noteholders as designated purchaser under a Master Purchase Agreement dated November 14, 2025 (as amended). All requisite state regulatory approvals were obtained prior to closing. The transactions contemplate transferring remaining market assets and winding down the existing AYR corporate parent entity.
